core_meaning.primary_meaning: Adal corresponds to the Arabic form عدل and is glossed in this record as “Justice, equity.” The record associates the form with root ع د ل (ʿ-d-l). The lexical gloss describes the word-form; Qur’anic occurrence, religious recommendation, popularity, and a name-bearer’s character are separate claims and are not established by this gloss alone.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Adal corresponds to the Arabic form عدل (Arabic root ع د ل (ʿ-d-l); عَدْل (ʿadl)). Its core sense is justice; equity. Adal is Arabic عَدْل (ʿadl) 'Justice, equity', the verbal noun of عَدَلَ (ʿadala, 'to be just, to act justly') from the root ع د ل (ʿ-d-l).

etymology.morphology: Verbal noun (maṣdar) of عَدَلَ (ʿadala, 'to be just, to act justly'), from the root ع د ل.
etymology.etymological_meaning: From the root ع د ل (ʿ-d-l)
etymology.etymology_explanation: The form عدل is an established Arabic lexical item — the verbal noun of the root ع د ل — and Adal is the word itself used as a personal name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
etymology.false_etymology_warning: No derivation beyond the documented Arabic form is asserted. Any etymology that attributes this spelling to a different root or language without a source should be treated as unverified.

persian.name: عدل
persian.long_meaning: Adal (عدل) نامی برگرفته از زبان عربی است و معنای اصلی آن عدل، انصاف، داد است. این نام در جوامع مسلمان به کار می‌رود و کاربرد آن بسته به بافت زبانی متفاوت است.
